caption: The drawing features a men's historical costume composed of a long, dark brown coat with elaborate floral embroidery in shades of purple, green, yellow, and white along the edges, cuffs, and pockets. The coat is worn over a light-colored, possibly white, waistcoat that is also decorated with floral patterns similar to those on the coat. The breeches are dark brown and match the coat in color. The costume has white stockings covering the legs and plain, light-colored shoes. The head, hands, and feet below the ankles are not included in detail. To the lower right side of the drawing, there is a separate sketch of the floral embroidery design, highlighting the details and colors used on the costume. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the garments and their decorative elements.
title: Man's Court Suit
